'''Jungle Sign''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds a [[Stonecutter]] recipe (from <span class="explain" title="Jungle Log, Jungle Wood, Stripped Jungle Log, Stripped Jungle Wood">any jungle logs</span>). See {{MCW|Jungle Sign}} for everything else.
